high_costs.name: High costs
high_costs.desc: Three times the slippage and 7 more commission per lot: does the result survive worse fills?

detail.tradesStored: The first {{stored}} of {{total}} trades are stored.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.notFinished: Every compared run must be finished.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.l0: bar-based approximation: the order of prices inside a bar is unknown (SL assumed first)
limitations.l1: spread from the bar field or a fixed model, not tick-accurate
limitations.l2: no requotes, partial fills or rejections other than margin
limitations.l3: news gaps and weekend gaps are only seen at the next bar's open
limitations.l4: past results do not predict future results

form.noHistory: The engine has not uploaded any history yet. On the engine computer run:

form.strategiesHint: None ticked: the strategies enabled in config.yaml.

problem.notEnded: The period must have ended: choose yesterday or earlier.
problem.risk: The risk must be a number above 0.

controls.active: Kill switch ACTIVE ({{mode}}): the bot opens no new trades.
controls.inactive: Kill switch off: the bot may trade within its limits.
controls.noControls: Support accounts have no trading controls.
controls.flattenOff: Flatten is switched off on the engine (KILL_SWITCH_FLATTEN_ALLOWED=false).

controls.engineCodeHint: The 6-digit code of the engine (CONTROL_TOTP_SECRET), not your sign-in code. Only the engine can check it.

halt.title: Activate the kill switch?
halt.body: The engine stops opening new trades. Open positions stay and are still managed (HALT).

flatten.title: Close every bot position?
flatten.body: The engine activates the kill switch in FLATTEN mode and closes all of the bot's positions on its next cycle. Manual positions are not touched.

close.title: Close {{position}}?
close.body: The engine closes this position at the market on its next cycle.

limits.title: Limits
limits.noAccount: The engine has not reported its account yet.
limits.localOnly: Limits can only be changed in config.yaml on the engine computer; the app never raises them.
